process.description: My role is not to make AI generate more content. It is to shape a capability into a product flow people can actually complete.

steps.title: Find the friction
steps.description: Start with real situations and user language to find information noise, broken handoffs and expensive decisions.

steps.title: Design the flow
steps.description: Turn ambiguity into inputs, states, decision points and outcomes so the AI capability has a legible place in the journey.

steps.title: Build with AI
steps.description: Use Vibe Coding to build something real and clickable while keeping boundaries, fallback states and human confirmation.

steps.title: Validate the details
steps.description: Use realistic screens, sample data and failure states to refine flow, copy, responsive behavior and performance.

steps.title: Ship the story
steps.description: Complete deployment, screenshots, explanation and working entry points so the value is easy to understand and verify.

capabilities.description: Four capabilities, one goal: move AI from “it can generate” to “people can use it reliably.”

items.title: AI Product Design
items.description: Connect user needs, model capability and human confirmation in one clear workflow.

items.title: Vibe Coding
items.description: Use Next.js and TypeScript to test product assumptions without losing engineering boundaries.

items.title: Multimodal Systems
items.description: Design understanding, confirmation and graceful fallback around multimodal input.

items.title: Product Delivery
items.description: Pair the prototype with a readable case study, working demo and deployment record.

about.bio1: I am a master's student in Logic at China University of Political Science and Law, trained in legal logic, mathematical logic and rule modeling. I use that foundation to turn messy real-world requirements into flows that AI can interpret and people can verify.
about.bio2: I currently build interactive prototypes with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and AI APIs, with a focus on structured analysis after voice, image and text input—and on lightweight but complete product delivery.
